name: n8n-feishu-adapter
description: Feishu (Lark) long-connection inbound adapter for the n8n Workflow-as-Code portfolio: a small host-side Node service that receives im.message.receive_v1 events over the Feishu WebSocket long connection (no public callback URL needed), maps a chat message to an allowlisted gateway intent, SIGNS the request (HMAC-SHA256, same scheme as the interaction-gateway edge), posts it to the local signed gateway, and replies in the chat with the sibling workflow's result. Pure core (event parsing / intent mapping / signing / reply building) is offline-tested; the WebSocket + HTTP shell is live-only.
